questions.question: What is a cell?
questions.answer: A cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life.

questions.question: Both plant and animal cells have a nucleus.
Which structure is found only in plant cells?
Fill in the blank: Plant cells contain ______ for photosynthesis.
What is the function of the cell membrane?
questions.answer: It controls the movement of substances into and out of the cell.

questions.question: Observe the image and identify the cell.
Which image represents an animal cell?
Animal cells do not have chloroplasts.
Fill in the blank: The ______ controls the activities of the cell.
Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
What is the function of chloroplasts?
questions.answer: They carry out photosynthesis to make food for the plant.

questions.question: Plant cells have a large central vacuole.
Observe the image and identify the highlighted organelle.
Which image shows the cell wall?
Explain one difference between plant and animal cells.
questions.answer: Plant cells have a cell wall and chloroplasts, while animal cells do not.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The jelly-like material inside the cell is called the ______.
Both plant and animal cells contain mitochondria.
Which organelle contains the genetic material of the cell?
Why do plant cells need chloroplasts?
questions.answer: They use chloroplasts to make food through photosynthesis.

questions.question: Explain the similarities between plant and animal cells.
questions.answer: Both have a cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, mitochondria, and other organelles needed for life.
